# deploy branch — generated, do not edit

Built output published by .github/workflows/deploy.yml on `main`.
Force-pushed as a single commit on every deploy, so nothing here is
history and any commit you make will be overwritten.

cPanel's Git Version Control tracks this branch. Its .cpanel.yml only
copies dist/ into the docroot — the build happens in CI because the
host cannot run it (see the workflow header for the full account).

Change the site by committing to `main`.
